description: No processes for managing ongoing PCI DSS compliance.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: For service providers, verify executive-level responsibility for PCI DSS compliance and documented compliance program charter. For all entities, monitor for compliance tracking mechanisms, quarterly and annual assessment schedules, and remediation management processes.

sources.title: PCI DSS v4.0
sources.section: Requirement 12: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies
